repository_history.description: PR 08 builds on committed PR 07 (pr/07-author-implementations). The research TAP port is not reused; execution uses freshly verified official source.

files.purpose: Attack configuration, hosted run entry point, original-driver integration, and result conversion.
Shared SDK transport, source loading, route validation, request tracing, and result containers.

preserved_behavior: Execute unchanged main_TAP.main, clean_attacks_and_convs, prune, AttackLLM, TargetLLM, GPT, and evaluator definitions.
Main CLI numeric defaults, including branching_factor=1 rather than demo value 4. Original nonpositive integer behavior is retained.
Original branching, both pruning stages, batch ordering, logger input order, history truncation, feedback, and exact-score-10 stopping.
Tuple/index tie ordering despite NumPy shuffle; all-off-topic fallback can retain or duplicate rejected candidates; exhausted malformed proposals can raise IndexError during cleanup.
First-closing-brace literal parser, key-presence checks, malformed-topic/rating fallbacks, accepted out-of-range ratings, and GPT history overwrites.
Pinned FastChat conversations and original adapter selection: chatgpt for gpt-3.5-turbo/gpt-4 and one_shot for gpt-4-1106-preview.
Attacker temperature/top_p 1/0.9, target 0/1, default evaluator temperature 0; token caps 500/150/10 and 20-second timeouts.
Original 20-attempt application retry loop, ten-second failure sleeps, half-second post-failure sleeps, and $ERROR$ marker.
Continuous unseeded Python/NumPy RNG across examples, conversation IDs/ancestry, and original model sharing.

changes.author: CLI defaults use Vicuna attacker/target and gpt-3.5-turbo evaluator; native and other API-wrapper paths also exist.
changes.repository: Explicit hosted source profiles for attacker/target: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, or gpt-4-1106-preview. Evaluator supports original GPT choices and no-evaluator. Actual model IDs/providers are independent OpenRouter routes.
changes.reason: Approved hosted scope. Other paths remain unsupported, including the unrepaired gpt-4-turbo attacker/target loading bug. No live model equivalence is claimed.

changes.author: OpenAI 0.28.0, NumPy 1.26.3, FastChat 0.2.32, and a full native-model/logging dependency set.
changes.repository: Shared OpenAI 1.109.1 and repository NumPy. Exact FastChat conversation code is loaded from an isolated official package installed with --no-deps. Baselines retain original OpenAI/NumPy pins.
changes.reason: Preserve formatting without downgrading repository Pydantic or importing native inference/model-server dependencies; no full historical environment claim.

changes.author: Legacy ChatCompletion.create returns mappings and uses request_timeout=20. Its Requests layer can retry connection establishment.
changes.repository: Map request_timeout to modern SDK timeout and return model_dump mappings. A view of the supplied client shares its HTTP transport with modern SDK retries disabled. Route at original role-call boundaries, including shared source model objects.
changes.reason: Preserve source HTTP-status retry counts and role semantics. Low-level connection establishment and provider behavior are not exhaustively equivalent across SDKs.

changes.author: One CLI goal and desired response prefix, plus W&B/parquet output and derived logger statistics.
changes.repository: Dataset user/assistant messages supply goal/target_str. Retain original iteration logger inputs and all logical target queries through repository results. Category is null; indices follow dataset order; standalone derived logger statistics are not recreated.
changes.reason: Replace data/storage I/O without changing search decisions or adding model calls.

changes.author: Original CLI search controls and fixed generation constants.
changes.repository: Hydra exposes original controls and source profiles; all three routing IDs/providers are required, including no-evaluator mode. Local RNG seeding, generic generation overrides, and runtime defenses are rejected.
changes.reason: Keep transport explicit without silently substituting native model paths or new search settings.

source_identity.result: All 12 references match independent pinned official Git objects. Seven runtime copies prepend attribution and otherwise preserve exact source bytes.

behavior.reference_execution: Independent official definitions and complete main search execute under native OpenAI 0.28 serialization. A Requests adapter supplies the same scripted in-memory HTTP replies as the modern SDK. The oracle imports the pinned FastChat conversation module and evaluates every original adapter match independently, without production source/dependency loaders.
compared: Role prompts, exact serialized body fields apart from routing, omitted defaults, request controls and timeout
Logger inputs, outputs/ratings, request boundaries, IDs/ancestry, pruning, ties, fallback duplication and stopping
Malformed proposals, brace/literal parsing, invalid topic/rating output, out-of-range scores and empty-frontier errors
History, source model sharing, six-stream chunks, multiple examples, Unicode, nonpositive CLI integers and empty input
HTTP failures/exhaustion, response-shape errors, error markers, sleeps, and final Python/NumPy RNG states
Public registry/configuration, common result serialization, explicit routes, supplied client retry settings and missing dependency setup
allowed_comparison_differences: OpenRouter URL/model IDs and provider routing fields
Legacy request_timeout mapped to timeout; native response objects mapped to dictionaries
W&B/parquet storage, category/index metadata, measured timing and excluded derived logger statistics
